resources.string:
Welcome to Word Scramble!

 How to Play: Unscramble the letters to form the correct word. Tap on letters to add them to your guess. Tap a selected letter in the guess area to remove it, or use the backspace button. Long-press backspace to clear your entire guess.

 Scoring:
 You get 10 points for each correct word.

 Clues:
 You start with 5 clues per game session. You can use up to 2 clues per word. In Endless Mode, you earn one clue every 3 rounds. A clue inputs the next correct letter where applicable

 Game Modes:
 - Endless: Play as many rounds as you like. Your score is saved when you choose to "Save and Quit".
 - 10 Rounds / 20 Rounds: Complete the set number of rounds. Your score is automatically saved at the end of the game.

 Good luck and have fun!

string-array.name: motivational_quotes
string-array.item: "It's okay to not be okay. Your feelings are valid, even the difficult ones."
"Healing doesn't mean the damage never existed. It means the damage no longer controls your life."
"The pain you feel today is the strength you feel tomorrow. For every challenge encountered, there is opportunity for growth."
"You are not weak for feeling hurt. You are human."
"Sometimes, the most courageous thing you can do is simply show up for another day."
"Grief is like the ocean; it comes in waves, ebbing and flowing. Sometimes the water is calm, and sometimes it is overwhelming. All we can do is learn to swim."
"Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise."
"Your current situation is not your final destination."
"It's okay to feel lost sometimes. Even the strongest GPS needs to recalculate."
"Tears are words the heart can't express."
"Hope is being able to see that there is light despite all of the darkness."
"You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think."
"The human spirit is stronger than anything that can happen to it."
"Even in the deepest valleys, a single star can show the way."
"Recovery is not one and done. It's a lifelong journey that takes place one day, one step at a time."
"Though nobody can go back and make a new beginning, anyone can start over and make a new ending."
"The wound is the place where the Light enters you."
"Every day may not be good, but there is something good in every day. Look for it."
"Just when the caterpillar thought the world was over, it became a butterfly."
"You've survived 100% of your worst days. You're doing great."
"Be gentle with yourself. You're doing the best you can."
"Talk to yourself like you would to someone you love."
"Rest is not a luxury, it's a necessity for healing."
"You are worthy of love and kindness, especially from yourself."
"Nourish yourself with kindness, patience, and understanding."
"Taking care of yourself doesn't mean 'me first,' it means 'me too.'"
"The most important relationship you will ever have is the one with yourself."
"Allow yourself to heal. It takes time."
"You don't have to earn your rest. You deserve it."
"Forgive yourself for not knowing what you didn't know before you learned it."
"You don't have to go through this alone. Reach out."
"Asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness."
"Connection is the opposite of addiction and despair."
"There are people who care about you and want to help you through this."
"A burden shared is a burden halved. Talk to someone."
"It's okay to lean on others when you need support."
"Find your tribe. Love them hard."
"Sometimes, the bravest thing you can do is ask for help."
"Your voice matters, and your story deserves to be heard."
"Help is available. You are not a burden for seeking it."
"One small step forward is still a step."
"Focus on progress, not perfection."
"The future holds possibilities you can't yet imagine."
"This too shall pass. Hold on."
"You are capable of amazing things, even when it doesn't feel like it."
"Let your hope, not your hurt, shape your future."
"Keep putting one foot in front of the other. That's all you have to do right now."
"The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step."
"You are not defined by your scars, but by your strength in overcoming them."
"There is life beyond this pain. Believe in it."
